Review on Bayesian Filtering Algorithm
The mathematical foundation of our model is rooted in classical Bayesian
inference. The Bayesian approach is particularly suitable for combining in a
rational manner heterogeneous non-Gaussian sensor observations with other

spans.text: sources of quantitative and qualitative information [6][7].

lines.text: sources of quantitative and qualitative information [6][7].

spans.text: In Bayesian analysis any quantity that is not known is considered a random

lines.text: In Bayesian analysis any quantity that is not known is considered a random
variable. The state of knowledge about such a random variable is expressed
in the form of a probability density function (PDF). Any new information in
the form of a probabilistic observation is combined with the prior PDF using
the Bayes’ theorem in order to update the state of knowledge and form a new

spans.text: posterior PDF. That PDF forms the quantitative basis on which all inferences, or

lines.text: posterior PDF. That PDF forms the quantitative basis on which all inferences, or
control decisions are made. [1]
